Directs the movement of trains to avoid collisions and bottlenecks.

Path Signals are advanced signals that are especially useful for bi-directional Railways and complex intersections. They function similarly to Block Signals, but rather than occupying the entire Block, trains can reserve a specific path through it and will only enter the Block if their path allows them to fully pass through.

Caution: Signals are directional! Trains are unable to move against this direction, so be sure to set up Signals in both directions for bi-directional Railways.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Portal/Description:
Enables pioneer teleportation between two linked Portals.

Each Portal can only have a single link. 
A link can only be made between a Main and Satellite Portal.

Singularity Cells need to be supplied to the Main Portal and will be consumed to establish and maintain the Portal link.

WARNINGS:
- Massive power draw will occur during start-up and usage.
- Power draw on use increases with travel distance.
- Link start-up will take time. Letting the connection expire is not recommended.
- Failure to deliver sufficient Singularity Cells will cause the link to expire.
- FICSIT does not condone the use of wormhole technology. Any usage of wormhole technology is at the user's own risk.
Buildables_Data.Power/PowerSwitch/Description:
Enables/disables the connection between 2 power grids when switched ON/OFF.

Note the A and B connector labels.
Buildables_Data.Production/OilExtractor/Description:
Extracts Crude Oil when built on an oil node. Extraction rates vary based on node purity.

Default Extraction Rate: 120 m³ of oil per minute.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)
Buildables_Data.Production/MinerMk.2/Description:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on. 
Default extraction rate is 120 resources per minute. 
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.
Buildables_Data.Production/MinerMk.3/Description:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on. 
Default extraction rate is 240 resources per minute. 
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.
Buildables_Data.Production/MinerMk.1/Description:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on. 
Default extraction rate is 60 resources per minute. 
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.
Buildables_Data.Production/WaterExtractor/Description:
Extracts water from the body of water it is built on.
Note: the water needs to be sufficiently deep, and rivers are generally not deep enough.

Default Extraction Rate: 120 m³ of water per minute.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)
Buildables_Data.Transport/Drones/DronePort/Description:
Functions as home Port to a single Drone, which transports available input back and forth between its home Port and destination Port.
Drone Ports can have one other Port assigned as their transport destination.

The Drone Port interface provides delivery details and allows management of Port connections.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletMk3/Description:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall.

Allows for up to 10 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletMk1/Description:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall.

Allows for up to 4 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletMk2/Description:

Allows for up to 7 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletDoubleMk3/Description:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall. Has one connector on each side of the wall.

Allows for up to 10 Power Line connections per side.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletDoubleMk1/Description:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall. Has one connector on each side of the wall.

Allows for up to 4 Power Line connections per side.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.
Buildables_Data.Power/WallOutletDoubleMk2/Description:

Buildables_Data.Transport/Jump/UJellyLandingPad/Descript:
Generates a speed-dampening jelly.
Guarantees a safe landing.
Buildables_Data.Power/AlienPowerAugmenter/Description:
Generates power based on the total amount of power on the attached power grid.

This experimental technology is somehow able to extract power from the Somersloop by blasting it with energy.
Buildables_Data.Special/AWESOMESink/Description:
Got excess resources? Fear not, for FICSIT does not waste! The newly developed AWESOME Sink turns any and all useful parts into research data just as fast as you can supply them! 
Participating pioneers will be compensated with Coupons that can be spent at the AWESOME Shop.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Hyper/HypertubeBooster/Descrip: Grants a quick speed boost when traversing it at the cost of increased energy consumption.
Buildables_Data.Power/GeothermalGenerator/Description:
Harnesses geothermal energy to generate power. Must be built on a Geyser.

Caution: Power production fluctuates.

Power Production:
Impure Geyser: 50-150 MW (100 MW average)
Normal Geyser: 100-300 MW (200 MW average)
Pure Geyser: 200-600 MW (400 MW average)
Buildables_Data.Power/PowerTower/Description:
Helps span Power Lines across greater distances.
There is an additional power connector at the bottom of the Power Tower to connect it to other buildings, such as Power Poles.
Buildables_Data.Power/PowerTowerPlatform/Description:
Helps span Power Lines across greater distances.
There is an additional power connector at the bottom of the Power Tower to connect it to other buildings, such as Power Poles.

Note: This Power Tower variant includes a ladder and platform for improved utility.
Buildables_Data.Organization/FluidBufferIndustrial/Descr:
Holds up to 2400 m³ of fluid.
Has Pipeline input and output ports.
Buildables_Data.Organization/FluidBuffer/Description:
Holds up to 400 m³ of fluid.
Has Pipeline input and output ports.

Light color and intensity can be adjusted.
Allows for up to 2 Power Line connections.

Buildables_Data.Transport/Jump/JumpPad/Description:
Launches pioneers for quick, vertical traversal.
The launch angle can be adjusted while building.
Caution: Be sure to land safely!
Buildables_Data.Organization/Lighting/StreetLight/Descri:
Lights up factory areas and roads.

Light color and intensity can be adjusted.
Allows for up to 2 Power Line connections.
Buildables_Data.Organization/Lighting/CeilingLight/Descr:
Lights up indoor factory spaces when placed on ceilings.

Light color and intensity can be adjusted via a Light Control Panel.
Allows for up to 2 Power Line connections.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/PipelineValve/Description:
Limits Pipeline flow rates.
Can be attached to a Pipeline.

NOTE: Has an in- and output direction.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Trains/Infrastructure/Platform:
Loads and unloads Freight Cars that stop at the Freight Platform.
Loading and unloading options can be set by configuring the building.
Snaps to other Platforms and Stations.
Needs to be connected to a powered Railway to function.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorMerger/Description: Merges up to three Conveyor Belts into one.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorMergerPriority/Descrip:
Merges up to three Conveyor Belts into one.
Inputs can be prioritized to always be merged before others.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Trains/Vehicles/Locomotive/Des:
Moves Freight Cars from station to station.
Requires between 25-110 MW of power to move. 
Must be built on a Railway.

Nicknamed 'Leif' by FICSIT pioneers because of its reliability.
Buildables_Data.Production/Packager/Description:
Packages and unpackages fluids.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Has both Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input and output ports so that a wide range of recipes can be automated.
Buildables_Data.Transport/RoadVehicles/Tractor/Descripti:
Picks up and delivers resources at Truck Stations. This process can be automated. Nicknamed 'Sugarcube' by FICSIT pioneers with the justification “It’s pretty sweet, y’know”.

Has 25 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type
Buildables_Data.Transport/RoadVehicles/Truck/Description:
Picks up and delivers resources at Truck Stations. This process can be automated. Nicknamed 'The Unit' by FICSIT pioneers because of its massive frame.

Has 48 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type
Buildables_Data.Transport/Hyper/HypertubeEntrance/Descri: Powers up a Hypertube system and allows it to be entered.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Trains/Infrastructure/RailwayB:
Prevents trains from derailing at the end of a railway.

While automated driving systems have made Buffer Stops mostly obsolete, their use is still recommended to mitigate potential human error.
Buildables_Data.Power/PowerSwitchPriority/Description: Priority Power Switches can be ranked by priority. When power production is too low, Switches will start turning off automatically until the power stabilizes, starting with Priority Group 8.
Buildables_Data.Organization/LookoutTower/Description: Provides a good vantage point to facilitate factory construction.
Buildables_Data.Special/AWESOMEShop/Description:
Redeem your FICSIT Coupons here! 
For those employees going the extra kilometer we have set aside special bonus milestones and rewards! Get your Coupons in the AWESOME Sink program now!

*No refunds possible.
Buildables_Data.Production/Refinery/Description:
Refines fluid and/or solid parts into other parts.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Has both Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input and output ports so that a wide range of recipes can be automated.
Buildables_Data.Special/SpaceElevator/Description:
Requires deliveries of special Project Parts to complete Project Assembly Phases.
Completing these Phases will unlock new Tiers in the HUB Terminal.
Buildables_Data.Organization/RadarTower/Description:
Scans the surrounding area to display additional information on the Map.

Information revealed on the Map includes:
- Resource node locations
- Terrain data
- Flora & fauna information
- Notable signal readings
Buildables_Data.Organization/Lighting/LightsControlPanel:
Sections off a series of lights, allowing them to be adjusted as a group.

Controls all lights connected to the power grid via the Light Connector (yellow label).
Note: Other Control Panels and Power Switches interrupt the connection.
Buildables_Data.Transport/RoadVehicles/Infrastructure/Tr:
Sends or receives resources to/from vehicles.

Has 48 inventory slots.

Transfers up to 120 stacks per minute to/from docked vehicles. 
Always refuels vehicles if it has access to a matching fuel type.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Trains/Infrastructure/TrainSta:
Serves as a hub for Locomotives, which can be set to navigate to and stop at a Train Station.
You can connect power to a Train Station to power up the trains on the Railway as well as feed power to other stations.
Buildables_Data.Production/Foundry/Description:
Smelts 2 resources into alloy ingots.

Can be automated by feeding ore in via Conveyor Belts connected to the input ports. The resulting ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.
Buildables_Data.Production/Smelter/Description:
Smelts ore into ingots.

Can be automated by feeding ore in via a Conveyor Belt connected to the input port. The resulting ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorSpitterSmart/Descripti:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three.
A filter can be set for each output to allow a specific part to pass through.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorSpitterProgrammable/De:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three. 
Multiple filters can be set for each output to allow specific parts to pass through.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorSpitter/Description:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three. 
Useful for diverting parts and resources away from backlogged Conveyor Belts.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/ConveyorPole/Stackable/Descrip: Supports Conveyor Belts. Can be stacked on other stackable supports.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Hyper/HypertubeSupport/Descrip: Supports Hypertubes, allowing them to stretch over longer distances.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Hyper/StackableHypertubeSuppor: Supports Hypertubes. Can be stacked on other stackable supports.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/PipelineSupportStackable/Descr: Supports Pipelines. Can be stacked on other stackable supports.
Buildables_Data.Special/BlueprintDesigner/Description:
The Blueprint Designer is used to create custom factory designs and save them as Blueprints.
Blueprints can be accessed from the Blueprint tab of the Build Menu.

Note that buildings can only be placed in the Blueprint Designer if they are fully within the boundary frame.

Dimensions: 32 m x 32 m x 32 m
Buildables_Data.Special/BlueprintDesignerMk2/Description:

Dimensions: 40 m x 40 m x 40 m
Buildables_Data.Special/BlueprintDesignerMk3/Description:

Dimensions: 48 m x 48 m x 48 m
Buildables_Data.Production/Converter/Description:
The Converter harnesses Reanimated SAM to enable precise matter and energy transmutation.

Warning: Power usage is very high and unstable.
Buildables_Data.Organization/DimensionalDepot/Descriptio:
The Dimensional Depot Uploader is used to upload resources to a dimensional storage deposit.
From here resources can be used by the Build Gun and Crafting Stations, as if they were in the pioneer Inventory.
Buildables_Data.Special/MAM/Description/Standalone:
The Molecular Analysis Machine is used to analyze new and exotic materials found on alien planets.
Through the MAM, R&D will assist pioneers in turning any valuable data into usable research options and new technologies.
Buildables_Data.Special/MAM/Description/Integrated:
The Molecular Analysis Machine is used to break down matter for analysis and send the data back to Earth.
R&D is interested in this data, so they will compensate you for what you send.
Buildables_Data.Production/QuantumEncoder/Description:
The Quantum Encoder uses Excited Photonic Matter to produce the most complex of parts, controlling development up to the quantum level.

Warning: Power usage is extremely high and unstable.
Buildables_Data.Special/HUB/Description: The heart of your factory. This is where you complete FICSIT milestones to unlock additional schematics for buildings, vehicles, parts, equipment, etc.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Hyper/Hypertube/Description:
Transports FICSIT employees.
A Hypertube system cannot be powered up or used until a Hypertube Entrance is attached.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Elevators/PersonnelElevator/De:
Transports FICSIT personnel between floors while meeting acceptable standards for efficiency and safety.
Consumes power when in use and transports power between all attached Elevator Floor Stops.

NOTE: Additional floor stops can be added with an Elevator Floor Stop.
Buildables_Data.Transport/Drones/Drone/Description:
Transports available input back and forth between its home Port and destination Ports. Drone Status and other details can be viewed at a Drone's home Port.
Must be built on a Drone Port.

Has 9 inventory slots.

Can use any fuel type.
Refuels at any of its connected Ports if possible.

Transports fluids.
Capacity: 300 m³ of fluid per minute.

Caution: This version of the Pipeline does not feature an external indicator.
Buildables_Data.Logistics/PipelineMk2NoIndicator/Descrip:
Transports fluids.
Capacity: 600 m³ of fluid per minute.

Caution: This version of the Pipeline does not feature an external indicator.

Buildables_Data.Transport/RoadVehicles/Explorer/Descript:
Traverses rough terrain, including near-vertical surfaces. A fast and nimble exploration vehicle.

Has 12 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type
Buildables_Data.Production/ParticleAccelerator/Descripti:
Uses electromagnetic fields to propel particles to very high speeds and energies. The specific design allows for a variety of processes, including matter generation and conversion.

Warning: Power usage is extremely high and unstable, and varies per recipe.

Power Consumption: 100 MW

Allows pioneers to move vertically and hover in mid-air to improve building efficiency and factory traversal. Wirelessly connects to nearby power connections, such as Power Poles and Buildings, for power consumption.

A high-impulse compressed gas fuel.
Can be used as-is to power Fuel-Powered Generators, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles or the Jetpack.

A radioactive element. 
Used to produce Encased Uranium Cells for Uranium Fuel Rods.

Caution: Moderately Radioactive.
Items_Data.Parts/Nobelisk/Description: A simple explosive, useful for clearing boulders, vegetation, and other obstacles.

Can be redeemed in the AWESOME Shop for bonus milestones and rewards.

Items_Data.Parts/CircuitBoard/Description: Advanced electronics that have a plethora of different uses.
Items_Data.Materials/AluminaSolutionPackaged/Descri: Alumina Solution, packaged for alternative transport.

Items_Data.Materials/BlackPowder/Description: An explosive powder that is commonly used to produce simple explosives.
Items_Data.Environment/Somersloop/Description: An odd alien object with a mind-bending, yet somehow familiar shape. It emits an unsettling energy.
Items_Data.Parts/OscillatorSuperposition/Descriptio: An oscillator circuit that uses the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal to create a string vibration with a precise frequency. Often used in teleportation technology and dimensional manipulation.
Items_Data.Parts/ColorCartridge/Description:
Applies Patterns to structures when used with the Customizer.

(Patterns can be purchased in the AWESOME Shop.)
Items_Data.Enviroment/PowerShardAlien/Description: Boosts production at the cost of increased energy consumption.

Items_Data.Parts/IronRebar/Description: Can be shot using the Rebar Gun for self-defense purposes.

Items_Data.Parts/Quickwire/Description: Caterium's high conductivity and resistance to corrosion make it ideal for small, advanced electronics.
Items_Data.Materials/DarkMatter/Description:
Concentrated Dark Matter Residue that is isolated within a crystalline vessel. This form of containment allows for utilising Dark Matter reliably in other production processes.

Power Usage: 500-1500 MW (1000 MW average).
Items_Data.Parts/HighSpeedConnector/Description: Connects multiple cables and wires in a very efficient way. Uses a standard pattern, so it has many varied applications.
Items_Data.Enviroment/HardDrive/Description: Contains FICSIT data. Analyze it in the MAM to salvage its contents.
Items_Data.Parts/AILimiter/Description: Controls AIs and keeps them from evolving in malicious ways. Super advanced electronics.
Items_Data.Parts/PressureConversionCube/Description: Converts outgoing force into internal pressure. Required to contain unstable, high-energy matter.
Items_Data.Parts/Motor/Description: Creates a mechanical force that is used to move things from machines to vehicles.
Items_Data.Materials/CrudeOilPackaged/Description: Crude Oil, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles.
Items_Data.Materials/Silica/Description: Derived from Raw Quartz. Commonly used to create glass structures, in advanced refinement processes, and for alternative production of electronics.
Items_Data.Materials/QuartzCrystal/Description: Derived from Raw Quartz. Used in the production of advanced radar technology and high-quality display screens.
Items_Data.Materials/AluminaSolution/Description: Dissolved Alumina, extracted from Bauxite. Can be further refined into Aluminum Scrap for Aluminum Ingot production.
Items_Data.Materials/QuantumEnergy/Description:
Excited Photonic Matter is essential for all production processes in the Quantum Encoder.

Formed in the Converter by inducing intense photon interactions through exposure to SAM in a high-energy environment.
Items_Data.Materials/IonizedFuel/Description:
Fuel that has been ionized, allowing it to deliver incredible output.
Can be used as-is to power Fuel-Powered Generators, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles or the Jetpack.
Items_Data.Materials/FuelPackaged/Description: Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.
Items_Data.Parts/AlienProtein/Description:
Ground-up Alien Remains in a neat little package.
Used for medical purposes and to research alien organisms.
Items_Data.Materials/CopperPowder/Description:
Ground-up Copper Ingots.
The high natural density of Copper, combined with the granularity of the powder, makes this part perfect for producing Nuclear Pasta in the Particle Accelerator.
Items_Data.Materials/NitrogenGas/Description: Has a variety of uses, including metallurgy, cooling, and Nitric Acid production. On MASSAGE-2 (AB)b, it can be extracted from underground gas wells.
Items_Data.Materials/HeavyOilResiduePackaged/Descri: Heavy Oil Residue, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles.
Items_Data.Materials/IonizedFuelPackaged/Descriptio: Ionized Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.
Items_Data.Parts/CoolingSystem/Description: Keeps advanced parts and buildings from exceeding efficient temperature levels.
Items_Data.Materials/LiquidBiofuel/Description: Liquid Biofuel can be used as-is to generate power, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles.
Items_Data.Materials/BiofuelLiquidPackaged/Descript: Liquid Biofuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.
Items_Data.Materials/Coal/Description: Mainly used as fuel for vehicles & Coal-Powered Generators, or in Steel production.

Used to produce Plutonium Fuel Rods for Nuclear Power production.

Items_Data.Enviroment/PowerShard/Description:

It radiates a strange power.
Items_Data.Parts/Battery/Description: Primarily used as fuel for Drones and vehicles.

Primarily used as fuel.

Items_Data.Materials/Wood/Description:
Primarily used as fuel.

Items_Data.Materials/Biomass/Description:
Primarily used as fuel.
Biomass Burners and vehicles can use it for power.
Biomass is much more energy-efficient than raw biological matter.
Items_Data.Materials/Sulfur/Description: Primarily used to produce Black Powder.

Items_Data.Parts/PipeSteel/Description: Primarily used when constructing slightly more advanced buildings.
Items_Data.Materials/DarkEnergy/Description:
Produced as a by-product of Quantum Encoding processes and alternatively generated in the Converter.

Various fields of science are still debating the nature and properties of Dark Matter. Meanwhile, FICSIT has found several applications for it in space-time manipulation.
Items_Data.Materials/SulfuricAcid/Description: Produced by combining Sulfur and Water in a complex reaction. Primarily used in refinement processes and Battery production.
Items_Data.Parts/FICSITIngot/Description:
Produced by reconstructing other metals on a molecular level using Strange Alien Matter.

Synthesized by FICSIT to be the perfect construction material, and used in the most high-end processes.
Items_Data.Parts/PlutoniumPellet/Description:
Produced in the Particle Accelerator through conversion of Non-fissile Uranium.
Used to produce Encased Plutonium Cells for Plutonium Fuel Rods.

Power Usage: 250-750 MW (500 MW average).
Caution: Moderately Radioactive.
Items_Data.Parts/UraniumPellet/Description:
Produced in the Refinery, Uranium Pellets are purified and cast from Uranium Ore. 
Primarily used to make Uranium Cells.

Caution: Moderately radioactive.
Items_Data.Materials/NitricAcid/Description: Produced when Nitrogen Gas reacts with Water. Its high corrosiveness and oxidizing properties make it an excellent choice for refinement and fuel production processes.

Project Part #10. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Years ahead of the competition, this top-of-the-line 3D printer is used for the production of synthetic biological resources.
Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part11/Description:
Project Part #11. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

A large amount of force is required for the Warp Drives to activate, so sticking them to rockets was the logical next step. Additionally, results improved immensely when the observers were further removed from the Warp Drives upon activation.
Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part12/Description:
Project Part #12. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.
Power Usage: 0-2000 MW (1000 MW average).

Growth is the metric by which we measure success.

Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part03/Description: Project Part #3. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part07/Description:
Project Part #6. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

This extremely fast and precise computing system is specifically designed to direct the Project Assembly: Assembly Phase.
Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part06/Description:
Project Part #7. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

These modular generators use superconducting magnets and vast amounts of electricity to produce a powerful and easily expandable magnetic field.
Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part08/Description:
Project Part #8. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Uses extreme heat to produce the high-pressure plasma required to get Project Assembly into motion.
Items_Data.SpaceElevator/Part09/Description:
Project Part #9. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.
Power Usage: 500-1500 MW (1000 MW average).

Nuclear Pasta is extremely dense degenerate matter, formed when extreme pressure forces protons and electrons together into neutrons. It is theorized to exist naturally within the crust of neutron stars.

Items_Data.Materials/CrudeOil/Description: Refined into all kinds of Oil-based resources, like Fuel and Plastic.
Items_Data.Materials/RocketFuelPackaged/Description: Rocket Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.
Items_Data.Materials/DissolvedSilica/Description:
Silica dissolved in Water, produced as part of the alternative refinement of Raw Quartz.
The Silica can be extracted from the Water to complete the refinement process.
Items_Data.Parts/BeamIndustrialEncased/Description:
Simultaneously utilizes the compressive strength of concrete and the tensile strength of steel.
Mostly used as a stable base for constructing buildings.
Items_Data.Parts/AluminumIngot/Description:
Smelted from Aluminum Scrap, which is refined from Alumina Solution.
Used to produce specialized aluminum-based parts.
Items_Data.Parts/CateriumIngot/Description: Smelted from Caterium Ore. Primarily used for advanced electronics.
Items_Data.Parts/SteelIngot/Description: Smelted from a combination of Iron Ore and Coal. Can be made into several parts used in building construction.
Items_Data.Materials/CateriumOre/Description: Smelted into Caterium Ingots, which are primarily used for advanced electronics.
Items_Data.Materials/SAM/Description: Strange Alien Matter, commonly referred to as SAM, doesn't seem to follow the known laws of physics. It whispers of new possibilities.
Items_Data.Materials/SulfuricAcidPackaged/Descripti: Sulfuric Acid, packaged for alternative transport.
Items_Data.Materials/Diamonds/Description:
Synthetic Diamonds produced by exposing Coal to extreme heat and pressure.

Used in the production of Time Crystals and Dark Matter Crystals.

Power Usage: 250-750 MW (500 MW average).
Items_Data.Parts/FICSITMesh/Description: The Ficsite Trigon, made from Ficsite Ingots, is perfectly shaped for all construction challenges. Its performance is so exceptional, it basically solved structural engineering.
Items_Data.Parts/TemporalProcessor/Description: The Neural-Quantum Processor utilizes a combination of neural network architecture and quantum computing techniques to achieve unprecedented performance. This technology has enabled some of FICSIT's biggest advancements in artificial intelligence and relativistic engineering.
Items_Data.Parts/SAMFluctuator/Description:
The SAM Fluctuator is able to regulate and direct the behavior of Reanimated SAM through the application of electric charges with varying frequencies.
This control facilitates technologies such as matter-to-energy conversion and spatiotemporal matter manipulation.
Items_Data.Materials/UraniumNonFissible/Description:
The Uranium-238 isotope is non-fissile, meaning it cannot be used for nuclear fission. It can, however, be converted into fissile Plutonium in the Particle Accelerator.

Caution: Mildly Radioactive.
Items_Data.Parts/SAMAwakened/Description:
The active and contained form of the Strange Alien Matter.

Proper electromagnetic containment is required, as it appears to be able to manipulate the atomic bonds of any matter it comes into contact with.
Items_Data.Materials/PlutoniumWaste/Description:
The by-product of consuming Plutonium Fuel Rods in a Nuclear Power Plant.
Must be stored in a safe location. Handle with caution.

Caution: EXTREMELY Radioactive.
Items_Data.Materials/UraniumWaste/Description:
The by-product of consuming Uranium Fuel Rods in a Nuclear Power Plant.
Non-Fissile Uranium can be extracted. Handle with caution.

Caution: HIGHLY Radioactive.

The carapace of an alien Hog creature.
Used for MAM research.

This intricate condensed-matter matrix is used to enhance the output of the Alien Power Augmenter.

Initially developed in efforts to create a human-made Somersloop, the Alien Power Matrix cannot sustain the extra-dimensional energy connection on its own. However, it can effectively stabilize the energy stream of the Somersloop.
Items_Data.Parts/TimeCrystal/Description: Time Crystals are Diamonds that have been reconfigured on a sub-atomic level in the Converter to retain a time-periodic self-organizing structure. This allows them to be used in the development of quantum processing and storage technologies.
Items_Data.Parts/AlienDNACapsule/Description:
Translates organic chemicals into readable alien genetic information.
Used for researching alien organisms.

Go the extra kilometer! Knowledge is power, and power is just efficiency with fewer steps. Depositing Alien DNA Capsules in the AWESOME Sink provides FICSIT with knowledge, and pioneers with Coupons.

MAM_Data.Categories/Nutrients/PreUnlockDescriptio: Due to the presence of herbivorous megafauna, there is potential for the existence of edible plant matter that could be compatible with the human digestive system.
MAM_Data.Categories/HardDrive/PostUnlockDescripti: Hard Drives can be recovered from Freighter Crash Sites and scanned for usable data. During data reconstruction, any packages containing alternate options for FICSIT production pipelines will be prioritized.
MAM_Data.Categories/Caterium/PostUnlockDescriptio: Named after FICSIT's greatest CEO, Caterina Parks, Caterium is a new metal with properties similar to gold, such as conductivity and corrosion resistance. With minimal effort, it can be used to replace gold in the development of advanced electronics. It is unclear whether this is a naturally occuring element.
MAM_Data.Categories/AlienOrganisms/PostUnlockDesc: Samples collected from local megafauna can be used to produce applicable pioneer survival tools, and will also further FICSIT research into extraterrestrial lifeforms and nutritional programs.
MAM_Data.Categories/AlienOrganisms/PreUnlockDescr: Scans of MASSAGE-2 (AB)b have revealed the presence of several large alien lifeforms in the designated FICSIT zone. Retrieval and research are necessary to establish threat level, classification, and potential applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/PowerSlugs/PreUnlockDescripti: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b have revealed numerous small static sources of energy which break known natural conventions. Retrieval and research are necessary to establish classification and applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/Quartz/PreUnlockDescription: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b revealed a crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen. Retrieval and research are necessary to establish classification and applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/Caterium/PreUnlockDescription: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b revealed a metallic element as a potential new candidate for group 11 on the periodic table. Retrieval and research are necessary to establish classification and applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/Sulfur/PreUnlockDescription: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b revealed an unknown nonmetallic and multivalent chemical element largely present in a solid state. Retrieval and research are necessary to establish classification and applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/Mycelia/PreUnlockDescription: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b revealed several fungus-like growths potentially in possession of beneficial properties. Explore and acquire samples of their fruit bodies.
MAM_Data.Categories/AlienTechnology/PreUnlockDesc: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2 (AB)b revealed the presence of several [REDACTED] phenomena. Exposure is necessary to indicate locally specific use-cases. Exposure to these phenomena has not resulted in any notable effects in humans so far.
MAM_Data.Categories/HardDrive/PreUnlockDescriptio: Scans of planet MASSAGE-2(AB)b have revealed several non-functional FICSIT Freighters that may still contain valuable data and resources. Retrieval and research are needed to determine potential applications.
MAM_Data.Categories/Mycelia/PostUnlockDescription: Several species of fungi on MASSAGE-2 (AB)b possess a mycelial network consisting of unusually tough hyphae. These root-like structures show potential for pest control, medicinal use, and strong but lightweight natural fabrics.
MAM_Data.Categories/Sulfur/PostUnlockDescription: Sulfur can be extracted from these sulfide-sulfate mineral mixtures for use in volatile obstacle clearing and pioneer defense methods. Not recommended for use in perfume.
MAM_Data.Categories/FICSMAS/PostUnlockDescription:
The FICSMAS seasonal event is active during the months of December and January on Earth. This MAM tree contains recipes, decorations, and progression of the Giant FICSMAS Tree. Special Event Data Cartridges necessary for unlocking new branches in the MAM can be found in the Event Calendar. 

Any resemblance to external holidays, celebrations, seasonal events, traditions, cultural or religious, historical or contemporary, and/or their products, is entirely intended and by design. Because FICSIT cares about its employees and their diverse backgrounds.
MAM_Data.Categories/Nutrients/PostUnlockDescripti: There are several edible fruits and fungi present in your designated FICSIT zone that are compatible with the human digestive system. Beyond nutritional value, these might also have medicinal properties.
MAM_Data.Categories/AlienTechnology/PostUnlockDes: These alien resources possess several unique and rare properties that, after years of careful study and experimentation, can now be utilized by FICSIT pioneers. Due to the unpredictable and volatile nature of this technology, every FICSIT pioneer must progress through a mandatory research and development structure. This ensures no catastrophic events relating to spatial manipulation or extra-dimensional matter harvesting will interfere with the Save the Day program.
MAM_Data.Categories/PowerSlugs/PostUnlockDescript: This semi-slug species is capable of extracting latent energy from its surroundings, which is stored in its porous semi-crystalline shell. Its color indicates where in its lifecycle it is, and thus the amount of energy stored. Even the youngest of Power Slugs puts Earth's electric eel to shame. This unique energy source may be harnessed to increase the efficiency of many FICSIT production lines.
MAM_Data.Categories/Quartz/PostUnlockDescription: This variation of Quartz has a microstructure unique to this planet and can be recognized by its large prismatic shapes and opaque pinkish hue. These crystals are flawless to a degree usually only found in synthetic Quartz. This mineral can be refined for use in communication and exploration technologies.
MAM_Data.Categories/FICSMAS/PreUnlockDescription: Unfortunately it is time for a FICSIT seasonal event taking place during the Earth months of December and January. This MAM tree will be unlocked by using the Calendar in the HUB. It is never too late to opt out of this event, but of course the earlier the better.

A very small percentage of individuals may experience epileptic seizures when exposed to certain visual images, including light patterns or flashing lights that may appear in videogames or other content. Exposure to certain patterns or backgrounds on a computer screen, or while playing videogames, may induce an epileptic seizure in these individuals. Certain conditions may induce previously undetected epileptic symptoms even in persons who have no history of prior seizures or epilepsy.

If you, or anyone in your family, have an epileptic condition, consult your physician prior to playing Satisfactory. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing - dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of awareness, disorientation, any involuntary movement, or convulsions -  discontinue use IMMEDIATELY  and consult your physician before resuming use of Satisfactory.

Greetings, pioneers!

Welcome to the <BoldRed>Experimental build of Satisfactory.</> It includes the newest content that we need to test before we push it to the stable build. This means that we might introduce game- or potentially save- breaking bugs to this version, so <Bold>tread with caution!</>

This is the directory where you will find your saves:
<Bold>%localappdata%\FactoryGame\Saved\SaveGames\</>

You will also experience regular bugs, crashes, visual issues, and performance issues. All the good stuff. We would really appreciate your honest feedback, no matter what it is. Please go to our questions site <Bold>https://questions.satisfactorygame.com/</> and let us know what you think.

World_Data.Locations/DuneDesert/Description: Initially considered too risky, further investigation has convinced us that this area is viable for building with its large, open spaces and plentiful mining locations. Foliage and water locations are rare and contained, making initial power set-ups challenging.
World_Data.Locations/GrassFields/Description: The first viable building location FICSIT had found, standing out because of its open and relatively flat fields. Considering the distances between mining locations, building outposts and/or large transportation lines may be necessary eventually.
